behavior: When saving a CMS page title, the app copies to clipboard and sends zero network writes.
test: it('CMS copy sends zero writes', async () => { render(<TitleEditor page={cmsItem}/>); await user.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:/copy/i})); expect(navigator.clipboard.writeText).toHaveBeenCalledWith('New title'); expect(fetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); expect(screen.getByText('Copied to clipboard')).toBeVisible(); })

behavior: When saving a CMS page title, the app copies to clipboard and sends zero network writes.
test: it('renders', () => { const spy = vi.fn(); render(<TitleEditor page={cmsItem} onSave={spy}/>); expect(spy).toBeDefined(); })
